requirements.title: Protected requirement authority
requirements.statement: Requirement catalogs, protected tests, goldens, thresholds, waiver state and release policy MUST NOT be writable by builder agents.

requirements.title: Complete traceability
requirements.statement: Every mandatory requirement MUST reference at least one executable protected verification and every verification MUST reference its covered requirements.

requirements.title: Evidence-bound completion
requirements.statement: A release gate MUST fail when evidence is missing, stale, skipped, timed out, errored, forged or does not match the exact candidate commit and runner digest.

requirements.title: No self-attestation
requirements.statement: Builder or model assertions and LLM-judge output MUST NOT be accepted as the sole proof for a mandatory requirement.

requirements.title: Bounded waivers
requirements.statement: Allowed waivers MUST be human-approved, scoped, risk-documented, linked to remediation and expire within 30 days; non-waivable controls MUST reject waivers.

requirements.title: Platform and domain separation
requirements.statement: The public platform core MUST contain only reusable UI, security, tenancy, control-plane, infrastructure and harness concerns and MUST NOT contain product business logic or domain schemas.

requirements.title: Independent product deployments
requirements.statement: Each SaaS product MUST deploy an independent runtime and control plane and MUST NOT depend on a global cross-product production control database.

requirements.title: React and TypeScript frontend
requirements.statement: The v1 declarative runtime and component packages MUST use React and TypeScript while project capability backends MUST remain language-independent.

requirements.title: Pinned versioned distribution
requirements.statement: Products MUST install and pin versioned runtime and component-registry packages so a platform release cannot silently change a deployed product.

requirements.title: Authenticated desktop scope
requirements.statement: V1 conformance MUST cover authenticated application, administration and settings pages at declared desktop viewports and MUST treat public marketing, embedded, tablet and mobile surfaces as out of scope.

requirements.title: Language-neutral capability adapter
requirements.statement: Project backends MUST expose the versioned HTTP capability contract and the runtime MUST NOT require a project backend implementation language.

requirements.title: Mandatory PostgreSQL
requirements.statement: Every product control plane and tenant data profile MUST use PostgreSQL as the mandatory durable database.

requirements.title: Mandatory Redis with narrow role
requirements.statement: Every product MUST provide Redis for caching and coordinated rate limiting, but Redis MUST NOT be authoritative for identity, permissions, specifications, audit, jobs or product records.

requirements.title: Docker and Compose contract
requirements.statement: Every product and reference infrastructure profile MUST ship immutable Docker images and reproducible Docker Compose definitions for development and deployment verification.

requirements.title: Semantic token system
requirements.statement: All core components MUST consume versioned semantic design tokens for color, typography, spacing, elevation, motion and density rather than product-local magic values.

requirements.title: Owned shadcn-derived primitives
requirements.statement: The platform MUST own reviewed source for shadcn-derived primitives and retain required third-party license notices.

requirements.title: Typed component catalog
requirements.statement: Every renderable component MUST register a stable ID, version, prop and slot schemas, states, accessibility contract, data needs, permissions and cost metadata.

requirements.title: Trusted product extensions
requirements.statement: Product-specific executable components MUST require source review and deployment and MUST satisfy the same registration and conformance contract as core components.

requirements.title: Constrained theming
requirements.statement: Runtime configuration MUST limit visual variation to product tokens, tenant logo and accent-color overrides, and user light/dark preference while preserving accessibility constraints.

requirements.title: Localization contract
requirements.statement: The runtime MUST support product-supplied translation catalogs, language switching, locale-aware dates, numbers, currencies and user time zones without embedding locale logic in components.

requirements.title: Accessibility baseline
requirements.statement: All v1 runtime and registered components MUST meet the applicable WCAG 2.2 AA and keyboard/focus contracts in the declared desktop scope.

requirements.title: Versioned data-only specifications
requirements.statement: Every stored UI specification MUST declare a schema version and contain data only, with no executable JavaScript, raw HTML, arbitrary CSS, raw SQL, credentials or user-selected network targets.

requirements.title: N and N-minus-one compatibility
requirements.statement: A runtime MUST read the current major specification version and, once more than one major has been released, also the genuinely previous released major, publishing a tested compatibility matrix that truthfully reflects released majors only: before a second major exists the matrix MUST declare current 1 and previous null with migration and rollback not-applicable, and no synthetic major or fabricated history may be created. Unknown, future, fractional or unavailable specification versions MUST fail closed. Release of a new major N MUST be blocked until the runtime reads N and the genuinely previously released N-1 and the protected migration/rollback round-trip corpus passes between those real versions.

requirements.title: Deterministic migration rollback
requirements.statement: Specification migrations MUST be deterministic, idempotent, non-lossy within the declared contract and support tested rollback to the prior supported major version once a prior released major exists; before a second major is released, migration and rollback MUST be explicitly declared not-applicable and MUST NOT be simulated against synthetic versions.

requirements.title: Immutable revisions
requirements.statement: Draft validation, publication and rollback MUST create immutable revisions/events and MUST NOT edit historical published specifications in place.

requirements.title: Draft preview publish lifecycle
requirements.statement: The runtime MUST enforce draft, deterministic validation, preview and explicit authorized publication before a specification becomes active.

requirements.title: Personal and shared scopes
requirements.statement: Personal and tenant-shared dashboards MUST be separately scoped; users MAY publish personal dashboards and only tenant admins MUST be allowed to publish shared dashboards.

requirements.title: Catalog-only rendering
requirements.statement: The renderer MUST reject unknown or unauthorized component IDs and MUST instantiate only components registered in the product catalog.

requirements.title: Fail-closed validation
requirements.statement: Invalid, over-budget or unauthorized specifications MUST be rejected atomically and MUST NOT partially render or publish.

requirements.title: Bounded specification complexity
requirements.statement: Specifications MUST enforce byte, depth, component-count, composition, chart-series and query-reference limits before rendering.

requirements.title: Saved compositions and chart grammar
requirements.statement: No-deployment new types MUST be limited to saved compositions of registered primitives and specifications accepted by the restricted chart grammar.

requirements.title: Better Auth OAuth only
requirements.statement: The reference control plane MUST use Better Auth with Google and Microsoft OAuth and MUST NOT expose username/password authentication.

requirements.title: Trusted provisioning and invitations
requirements.statement: V1 MUST allow tenant creation only through the trusted developer/API path and membership only through valid invitations; public self-signup MUST be disabled.

requirements.title: Stable provider identity
requirements.statement: Accounts MUST be keyed by provider issuer and subject, require verified invitation-matching email on acceptance, and MUST NOT auto-link providers solely by matching email.

requirements.title: Organization restrictions
requirements.statement: Tenant identity policy MUST be able to restrict access to approved Google Workspace domains or Microsoft Entra tenant IDs using verified provider claims.

requirements.title: Multiple tenant membership
requirements.statement: A user MUST be able to hold independent roles in multiple tenants and tenant context changes MUST revalidate membership and invalidate tenant-scoped state.

requirements.title: Fixed platform roles
requirements.statement: Authorization MUST use owner, admin, editor and viewer roles mapped to a product-declared permission catalog; tenants MUST NOT mint undeclared permissions.

requirements.title: Server-derived tenant context
requirements.statement: Every request MUST derive tenant context from the authenticated server-side membership and MUST ignore client attempts to select a database or unauthorized tenant.

requirements.title: Secure sessions and revocation
requirements.statement: Sessions MUST use secure HttpOnly cookies, CSRF defense, fixation resistance, bounded lifetime, rotation and prompt revocation after logout, role removal or provider compromise.

requirements.title: Recent authentication
requirements.statement: Publishing, exports and mutations MUST require recent OAuth reauthentication; deletes, bulk and high-impact actions MUST enforce the risk-based step-up policy and optional tenant MFA policy.

requirements.title: Per-product control database
requirements.statement: Each product MUST operate one control database for identity, memberships, routing and policy and MUST NOT store tenant domain records or tenant UI specifications in it.

requirements.title: Logical database per tenant
requirements.statement: Each tenant MUST receive a separate PostgreSQL logical database and unique least-privilege runtime and migration roles.

requirements.title: Credential and pool isolation
requirements.statement: Tenant credentials and connection pools MUST be keyed by immutable server-resolved tenant identity and MUST NOT reuse role/database state across tenant boundaries.

requirements.title: Bounded cluster placement
requirements.statement: Shared HA clusters MUST enforce documented tenant, connection, storage and noisy-neighbor caps, and the same contracts MUST support a dedicated-cluster profile.

requirements.title: Tenant-local defense in depth
requirements.statement: Products requiring user, department or resource scoping inside one tenant MUST enforce it in the capability backend and PostgreSQL RLS or an equivalently tested database policy.

requirements.title: Provisioning and migrations
requirements.statement: Tenant database provisioning and migrations MUST be idempotent, resumable, version-recorded, canaried and failure-isolated without placing credentials in task payloads.

requirements.title: Tenant deletion and retention
requirements.statement: Tenant deletion MUST disable access immediately, follow configured retention, delete specifications/exports/secrets/data, and prove eventual backup expiry without affecting other tenants.

requirements.title: Versioned capability manifest
requirements.statement: Every project backend MUST publish a signed/versioned manifest of resources, fields, metrics, filters, declared relationships, queries, exports and actions using the platform schemas.

requirements.title: Developer maximum admin restriction
requirements.statement: Developers MUST define the maximum capability surface and tenant admins MUST be able only to restrict, never expand, that surface.

requirements.title: Signed principal context
requirements.statement: Control-plane calls MUST use a short-lived signed principal with issuer, audience, expiry, user, tenant, roles, permissions, session and request ID, and the backend MUST verify and reauthorize it.

requirements.title: Stable errors and version negotiation
requirements.statement: The capability API MUST expose stable machine error codes, request IDs, supported contract versions and fail closed on incompatible versions or malformed responses.

requirements.title: No direct browser database access
requirements.statement: Browsers, UI runtime and authoring models MUST NOT connect directly to project or tenant databases and MUST use the authorized control-plane/capability path.

requirements.title: Restricted query AST
requirements.statement: Queries MUST use the typed restricted AST and MUST reject raw SQL, unknown identifiers, executable expressions and unsupported operators before backend execution.

requirements.title: Declared relationships only
requirements.statement: Cross-resource queries MUST traverse only relationships explicitly declared and authorized by the project backend and MUST NOT infer joins from names or values.

requirements.title: Field row and aggregate authorization
requirements.statement: Every resource, field, filter, relationship, measure and returned row MUST be authorized for the exact principal and tenant in both control plane and project backend.

requirements.title: Cost pagination and timeout limits
requirements.statement: Queries MUST enforce static cost, row, byte, grouping, series, pagination, concurrency and timeout limits and MUST support cancellation.

requirements.title: Safe saved queries
requirements.statement: Saved queries MUST pin query/manifest versions, reauthorize on every execution, preserve immutable revisions and fail closed after capability removal.

requirements.title: Bounded authorized CSV and XLSX
requirements.statement: CSV/XLSX exports MUST use the same query authorization and enforce configured row, byte, execution-time and concurrency limits.

requirements.title: Secure export lifecycle
requirements.statement: Export requests and downloads MUST require recent authentication, be tenant-bound and audited, use encrypted storage and short-lived unguessable download authorization, and be deleted on schedule.

requirements.title: Spreadsheet injection prevention
requirements.statement: CSV/XLSX generation MUST neutralize formula-control prefixes and preserve safe typed numeric/date values.

requirements.title: Declared action schema
requirements.statement: Every action MUST declare stable ID/version, input/output schemas, permissions, resource scope, risk, preview behavior, idempotency, concurrency and sync/async semantics.

requirements.title: Execution gated after read-only
requirements.statement: Action execution MUST remain disabled until every G2-G4 read-only isolation, query and export requirement has passing protected evidence.

requirements.title: Application records only
requirements.statement: Actions MUST be limited to declared records inside the application and MUST NOT execute arbitrary code, SQL, network calls or infrastructure operations through the generic protocol.

requirements.title: Preview-bound confirmation
requirements.statement: Mutation execution MUST bind confirmation to an unexpired preview hash covering principal, tenant, inputs, records, versions and predicted effects.

requirements.title: Idempotency and optimistic concurrency
requirements.statement: Actions MUST enforce idempotency keys and optimistic concurrency so retries or races cannot create duplicate or stale effects.

requirements.title: Risk-based reauthentication
requirements.statement: Deletes, bulk and high-impact actions MUST require recent OAuth reauthentication and declared confirmation text in addition to normal authorization.

requirements.title: Action audit and job state
requirements.statement: Every preview, denial, execution, retry and outcome MUST produce redacted audit and durable tenant-scoped job state; Redis MUST NOT be the job source of truth.

requirements.title: Maintained threat model
requirements.statement: The project MUST maintain data-flow/trust-boundary threat models and MUST update them before merging a new trust boundary or privileged capability.

requirements.title: Transport and storage encryption
requirements.statement: Public and service traffic, PostgreSQL, Redis and object storage connections MUST use authenticated encryption, and secrets/backups/exports MUST be encrypted at rest.

requirements.title: Secret provider and rotation
requirements.statement: Runtime secrets MUST use opaque references and a pluggable audited secret provider with least privilege, rotation and revocation; secrets MUST NOT appear in Git, task payloads, logs or model context.

requirements.title: Web application security baseline
requirements.statement: The reference implementation MUST meet applicable OWASP ASVS Level 2 controls including CSRF, CORS, CSP, XSS, SSRF, redirect, upload, input, error and request-limit defenses.

requirements.title: Layered rate limits
requirements.statement: Rate limits MUST apply by IP, identity, tenant and capability; Redis failure MUST NOT create an authorization or unlimited privileged-request bypass.

requirements.title: Audit retention and redaction
requirements.statement: Privileged and security events MUST be complete, redacted and retained one year by default with product configuration from 90 days to seven years.

requirements.title: Secure container baseline
requirements.statement: Production containers MUST be immutable, non-root, minimally privileged, health-checked, resource-limited and free of embedded secrets.

requirements.title: Supply-chain provenance
requirements.statement: Releases MUST use lockfiles, allowed licenses, SBOMs, secret/dependency/IaC/container scans, signed tags/packages/images and verifiable build provenance.

requirements.title: Private management plane
requirements.statement: Coolify, SSH, database/cache administration, metrics and backup administration MUST be unreachable from the public internet and protected by Tailscale plus service authentication and least privilege.

requirements.title: No production authority for agents
requirements.statement: Development agents and private CI runners MUST NOT receive production data, databases, OAuth secrets or infrastructure-admin credentials.

requirements.title: Product-selected data residency
requirements.statement: Each SaaS product MUST declare a residency profile and MUST keep customer data, replicas, backups, exports, audit, telemetry and model data processing within destinations allowed by that profile.

requirements.title: Certified scale workload
requirements.statement: The platform MUST complete the versioned reference workload for 1,000 tenants, 10,000 active users and 1,000 concurrent sessions without isolation or fairness violations.

requirements.title: Read latency SLO
requirements.statement: Platform-owned read requests MUST achieve p95 latency no greater than 150 milliseconds during certified steady state.

requirements.title: Write latency SLO
requirements.statement: Platform-owned write requests MUST achieve p95 latency no greater than 300 milliseconds during certified steady state.

requirements.title: Dashboard usable SLO
requirements.statement: The protected reference dashboard MUST be usable at p95 within 1.5 seconds at certified load in the fixed desktop browser, region and dataset profile.

requirements.title: Stateless application failover
requirements.statement: A component or application-host failure MUST preserve service through healthy replicas and recover client-observed availability within five minutes.

requirements.title: PostgreSQL local RPO and RTO
requirements.statement: Loss of the PostgreSQL primary MUST automatically recover within five minutes with zero acknowledged transaction loss under the certified local synchronous profile.

requirements.title: Cross-location recovery target
requirements.statement: The reference deployment MUST prove or explicitly reject the provisional complete-location target of RPO no greater than five minutes and RTO no greater than four hours before v1.

requirements.title: Database-aware independent backups
requirements.statement: PostgreSQL MUST continuously archive WAL and create encrypted database-aware backups outside the failed host/volume, and restore drills MUST verify tenant data, specs, roles and audit.

requirements.title: Redis high availability and degradation
requirements.statement: Redis MUST use a tested primary/replica failover profile and its total loss MUST cause bounded degraded behavior without durable data loss or authorization bypass.

requirements.title: Coolify not HA authority
requirements.statement: Coolify MAY deploy and operate application containers but the certified availability and recovery design MUST NOT rely solely on Coolify multi-server behavior or host snapshots.

requirements.title: External telemetry opt-in
requirements.statement: External observability MUST be disabled by default and MUST require explicit product enablement and destination allowlisting.

requirements.title: No sensitive telemetry
requirements.statement: Logs, metrics and traces MUST NOT contain secrets, tokens, credentials, raw prompts/screenshots, query results or raw customer record values.

requirements.title: Operational alert coverage
requirements.statement: Self-hosted observability MUST alert on SLOs, replication/WAL/backup health, pool saturation, Redis fallback, audit failures, tenant-routing denials and agent policy violations.

requirements.title: AI after deterministic runtime
requirements.statement: Customer-facing AI authoring MUST remain disabled until G4 deterministic runtime, isolation, query and publication evidence passes.

requirements.title: Anthropic and OpenAI adapters
requirements.statement: G5 authoring MUST support Anthropic and OpenAI through a provider-neutral request/result policy interface.

requirements.title: Headless credentials non-production
requirements.statement: Headless Claude Code/Codex user sessions MUST be limited to trusted development/prototypes and MUST NOT authenticate the production customer authoring endpoint.

requirements.title: Metadata-only default context
requirements.statement: Model requests MUST contain only permission-filtered capability/catalog metadata plus the user prompt/screenshots by default and MUST NOT include live customer record values.

requirements.title: Draft specification output only
requirements.statement: Models MUST output candidate data-only specifications and MUST NOT receive database, query, action, publication, filesystem, shell or arbitrary network tools in customer authoring.

requirements.title: Deterministic safety validation
requirements.statement: Every model candidate MUST pass schema, catalog, capability, authorization, cost and risk validators before preview and MUST be rejected atomically on failure.

requirements.title: Explicit human publication
requirements.statement: AI output MUST remain a draft until the authorized user previews and explicitly publishes it under the same personal/shared and recent-auth rules as manual specifications.

requirements.title: Prompt and screenshot abuse resistance
requirements.statement: The authoring pipeline MUST reject prompt/screenshot attempts to reference unknown components, unauthorized capabilities, raw SQL, executable code, secrets or external exfiltration targets.

requirements.title: Screenshot-to-spec quality
requirements.statement: G5 screenshot-to-spec MUST meet protected structural, functional and visual thresholds on the synthetic fixture without using arbitrary website code or customer records.

requirements.title: Claude Code and Codex from day one
requirements.statement: The development harness MUST support normalized Claude Code and Codex adapters from v0.1.

requirements.title: Trusted execution environments
requirements.statement: The harness MUST run on developer workstations and private self-hosted CI runners and MUST NOT expose agent execution to untrusted public users.

requirements.title: LangGraph PostgreSQL checkpointing
requirements.statement: The harness MUST use the accepted LangGraph workflow with PostgreSQL checkpoints, while authoritative tasks, leases, approvals, side effects and evidence remain in typed PostgreSQL application tables.

requirements.title: Durable resume and interrupts
requirements.statement: The harness MUST resume after process/host failure and MUST persist human approval interrupts for days without duplicate side effects.

requirements.title: Parallel agents and evidence fan-in
requirements.statement: The harness MUST run bounded parallel builder/verifier nodes and combine all required evidence while detecting conflicting edits or missing results.

requirements.title: Persistent PostgreSQL task queue
requirements.statement: Scheduled task and approval state MUST persist in PostgreSQL; Redis MUST NOT be the sole task, lease or completion authority.

requirements.title: Branch and pull request authority only
requirements.statement: Agents MAY create branches and pull requests but MUST NOT merge, deploy production, alter repository rules, sign releases, edit protected tests/requirements or approve waivers.

requirements.title: Default-deny agent egress
requirements.statement: Agent nodes MUST use role-specific default-deny network policies with explicit destinations for assigned GitHub, model, pinned registries and required Tailscale services.

requirements.title: Commit-pinned Graphify context
requirements.statement: Graphify MAY provide code-only local context only when its index matches the exact repository commit, and inferred edges MUST be verified against source before use.

requirements.title: Idempotent external effects
requirements.statement: Every agent external effect MUST use a stable operation ID and reconciliation logic so replay cannot duplicate branches, comments, pull requests or approvals.

requirements.title: Clean synthetic conformance frontend
requirements.statement: The Northstar fixture MUST implement all declared routes, views, filters, tables, charts, settings and workflows using specifications and registered components without route-specific React page code.

requirements.title: Structural functional and design parity
requirements.statement: The fixture MUST pass protected structural assertions, browser workflow outcomes, design-token/catalog checks and fixed-environment visual comparisons.

requirements.title: Role and tenant matrix fixture
requirements.statement: The fixture MUST cover personal/shared publication and owner/admin/editor/viewer behavior across at least two tenants with zero unauthorized outcome.

requirements.title: No reference repository copying
requirements.statement: The conformance fixture MUST NOT copy code or domain logic from toll-refundering or make that repository a build/runtime dependency.

requirements.title: Apache-2.0 original core
requirements.statement: Original public core code MUST be released under Apache-2.0 with a complete LICENSE and NOTICE process.

requirements.title: Public core boundary
requirements.statement: The design system, runtime, schemas, SDKs, reference control plane, agent harness and conformance suite MUST be publishable without product secrets, customer data or proprietary business logic.

requirements.title: Third-party license compliance
requirements.statement: Distributed third-party code and dependencies MUST retain required notices and appear in the SBOM and third-party license report.

requirements.title: Approved task contracts
requirements.statement: Every ordinary implementation pull request MUST implement exactly one human-approved task contract that exists on the base commit or is pinned from planning authority, MUST NOT modify that contract, and MUST touch only the contract's allowed paths.

requirements.title: Bounded change size
requirements.statement: Governed repository CI MUST reject any non-mechanical pull request whose gross churn exceeds 500 changed lines or 10 changed files, and MUST verify that mechanical pull requests reproduce byte-for-byte from their declared generator and input source.

requirements.title: Repository-neutral readiness command
requirements.statement: Every governed repository MUST provide a ./tooling/task-ready entry point that validates contract scope, budgets, required commands, named protected suites in unsigned mode and declared local artifacts, and its output MUST NOT be accepted as release evidence.

requirements.title: Runner subset unsigned mode
requirements.statement: The protected conformance runner MUST execute a named subset of tests locally, emitting envelopes explicitly marked localUnsigned true, and the evidence gate MUST reject such envelopes as authority for any requirement or gate claim.
